messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

Shipping is not refunded automatically; the item refund is based on what you paid for the kettle, excluding shipping (refund-policy/v2/shipping; refund-policy/v2/amount). Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?
